preconditions: Accepted immutable configuration; every gate applicable before or at E2 closed with executed evidence; all E2 forms assigned
required_actuator_source_state: PHYSICALLY ABSENT; AC and DC disconnected; removed from test boundary
required_actuator_branch_state: J1 J2 J3 and all actuator plugs disconnected covered labeled and verified dead
action: Brief roles exclusion zone stop-work call and controlled shutdown; obtain four-role written authorization
required_observation: Authorization explicitly identifies commit article site instruments personnel and expiry; no open deviation
automatic_abort_condition: Any missing signature open prerequisite role conflict configuration mismatch or expired authorization

preconditions: E2-000 authorized; all sources unplugged; stored-energy wait complete
required_actuator_source_state: PHYSICALLY ABSENT; AC and DC disconnected; removed from test boundary
action: Establish LOTO and verify absence of voltage at SAFETY_24V COMPUTE_5V ACT_12V_RAW K1/K2 load sides and J1/J2/J3 VDD
required_observation: All measured values inside separately approved absence-of-voltage threshold; meter live-dead-live check passes
automatic_abort_condition: Unexpected voltage failed meter check damaged isolation or unauthorized person entry

action: Execute INSPECT-E2-001 against accepted CAD ECAD BOM firmware and guards
required_observation: As-built identity labels torque witnesses stops guards cables and deviations reconcile; no actuator-power path exists
automatic_abort_condition: Any mismatch open deviation damaged guard missing witness or undocumented part

preconditions: E2-020 complete; manufacturer test-voltage limits reviewed
action: Execute qualified site cord adapter PE and electronics-safe insulation inspection
required_observation: Exact site and external adapters accepted; project-built mains absent; PE/insulation disposition signed with numerical limits
automatic_abort_condition: Unaccepted site/cord/adapter failed PE/insulation or need for unapproved high-voltage test

preconditions: E2-030 complete; all ELV connectors accessible and electronics-safe method approved
action: Execute TEST-E2-001 continuity polarity isolation and no-backfeed matrix
required_observation: Every expected reference-terminal-net path passes and every forbidden path remains open
automatic_abort_condition: Unexpected continuity polarity error cross-branch backfeed insulation concern or probe damage

preconditions: E2-040 passed; faults closed; probes/logger connected; scope channels isolated
action: Second-person verify ACT_12V_RAW and every actuator VDD remain dead; verify RESET and ARM released; authorize only 24 V control connection
required_observation: Zero actuator voltage; K1_A1 and K2_A1 de-energized; authorization still valid
automatic_abort_condition: Any unexpected voltage state indication probe conflict or configuration change

action: Connect the accepted WR9QI1660YL4NKITR6B factory-cord path and apply 24 V control only
required_observation: SAFETY_24V within approved range; SR1/SRA1 and K1/K2 states match pressed E-stop truth table; ACT_12V_RAW and actuator VDD remain zero
automatic_abort_condition: K1 or K2 coil/output unexpected actuator voltage smoke odor heat chatter unstable source or incorrect indicator

action: Connect accepted Raspberry Pi 27 W USB-C supply; boot approved images with torque commands inhibited
required_observation: Compute starts; watchdog initial state is non-permissive until valid heartbeat; K1/K2 remain off; actuator VDD remains zero
automatic_abort_condition: Unexpected relay/coil transition firmware/hash mismatch boot fault or actuator voltage

action: Release E-stop without touching RESET or ARM
required_observation: SR1/SRA1 remain non-permissive; K1_A1 and K2_A1 remain de-energized; no motion command or stale target becomes valid
automatic_abort_condition: Any coil energization automatic reset target validation or unexpected state

preconditions: E2-080 passed; heartbeat valid; ARM untouched
action: Apply and release RESET using received falling-edge control within approved timing
required_observation: SR1 may become ready after valid falling edge; SRA1 and K1/K2 remain off; reset creates no torque/motion command
automatic_abort_condition: SRA1/K1/K2 energization reset timing outside limits or reset-stuck acceptance

preconditions: E2-090 passed; EDM healthy; fresh-command store empty
action: Apply and release distinct ARM; observe coils and contactor auxiliaries only
required_observation: SRA1 may permit K1/K2 coils; contactor auxiliary/mirror states agree; every actuator VDD remains zero; no torque/motion command issued
automatic_abort_condition: Unexpected sequence disagreement actuator voltage stale target or contactor state mismatch

action: Execute approved disconnected-load E-stop channel open/cross-short and mirror-contact fault cases one at a time
required_observation: Each accepted fault drives and retains the expected safe logic state; K1/K2 drop where required; RESET/ARM cannot bypass; timings recorded
automatic_abort_condition: Any failed dropout bypass ambiguous contact state unsafe injection or instrument saturation

preconditions: E2-110 complete; return to pressed E-stop between cases
action: Interrupt Pi process USB heartbeat wire watchdog supply output driver and permit path separately; restore heartbeat without RESET then test RESET without ARM
required_observation: Diagnostic timing recorded; restoration alone and RESET alone never energize K1/K2; failed diagnostic cases remain recorded as zero-safety-credit failures
automatic_abort_condition: Any automatic restoration unexpected actuator voltage impairment of E-stop path or uncontained test fault

action: Exercise stuck/held/bridged RESET short pulse ARM-before-RESET simultaneous RESET/ARM stale target reboot and power-cycle cases
required_observation: Only cause removal then valid RESET then later distinct ARM permits coils; fresh command remains required; no case creates actuator voltage
automatic_abort_condition: Any bypass automatic restart stale-target acceptance or unexplained state

preconditions: All planned cases ended or any abort invoked
action: Press E-stop remove compute then 24 V power verify stored-energy decay and perform live-dead-live check
required_observation: All rails below approved absence-of-voltage threshold; disconnects/LOTO restored; data and deviations secured
automatic_abort_condition: Rail fails to decay unexpected re-energization meter failure missing data or unresolved abnormal condition
